name: Deepak Fertilisers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited
summary: Deepak Fertilisers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited engages in the manufacture, trade, and sale of bulk chemicals in India. It operates through the Chemicals, Fertilisers, and Realty segments. The company offers chemicals, including ammonia, methanol, dilute and concentrated nitric acid, carbon dioxide, iso-propyl alcohol, propane, and bulk and speciality chemicals; and fertilisers, such as nitro phosphate, mutriate of potash, diammonium phosphate ap, ammonium sulphate, mixtures, single super phosphate, sulphur, micronutrients, SSF, and bio fertilisers.
